informal_claim: The unary language U_B is in NP with oracle B: a nondeterministic polynomial-time oracle machine guesses an n-bit input x, queries the oracle about x, and accepts iff the oracle answers yes.
batch_narrative: Two renderings disagreed on how the membership claim is shaped. Renderings A (structure-first) puts the quantifier skeleton front-and-center; rendering B (witness-predicate) bundles the guessed witness x right into the membership predicate. Both encode the same intended claim; your answers close the disagreement.

probes.question: Does the machine have a way to choose which input to try?
choices: no, it must try them one at a time
probes.hint: NP means 'there exists a guess that leads to acceptance' — the machine is free to pick the right x if one exists.
probes.gloss: non-determininistic: a machine that can branch and accept if ANY branch accepts.

probes.question: Which statement does the claim assert?
choices: U_B is in NP with oracle B
NP with oracle B is in U_B
probes.expected: U_B is in NP with oracle B
probes.hint: The claim is a membership claim about U_B, not a containment direction between classes.

probes.question: Does the proof need to exhibit a concrete oracle machine?
probes.hint: NP membership is witnessed by a machine + a witness; forging that machine is the point of the campaign.

probes.question: What time bound does the claim use?
probes.hint: 'in NP' is a ceiling: the machine runs in at most polynomial time.
